beatPatches.purpose: Restore the bridge marker and bring the next misplaced lantern within reach
beatPatches.beat: Rabbit carries the recovered bridge lantern across without rushing ahead. Wise Turtle follows, and together they hang it on its original far-side post. From there, Rabbit spots the bramble lantern beside the path to the fork and picks it up.
beatPatches.endingPressure: With both beyond the bridge and the bramble lantern in hand, they can take it to the true fork marker.
requiredContinuity: Bridge lantern hangs at its original post
